description: Local repo is a strict ancestor of remote's HEAD (remote advanced by one commit past local's tip). phaseMergeGit must fast-forward and no divergence error occurs. This domain's real counterpart is the git binary itself (Art.2); the byte-for-byte repo state is built fresh per test run in t.TempDir() by TestPhaseMergeGit/clean-fast-forward rather than replayed from stored git objects, because commit hashes are timestamp-dependent -- the expected field below is the scenario's outcome contract, not a stored object.
